_comment: Maps ESP32 telemetry servo/motor/LED IDs to Fusion2URDF joint names. Edit this file to update mappings when hardware or URDF changes.

servo_joints._comment: Key format: 'group:channel'. Value: single joint name or array of joint names driven together.

dome_servo_joints._comment: Dome servos are children of LazySusan (dome). Key format: 'dome:channel'.

motor_joints._comment: Key: motor ID (string). Value: URDF joint name. Motors are continuous joints driven by speed.

motor_rad_per_sec._comment: Visual rotation speed (rad/s) at full motor value (|1.0|).

led_links._comment: Map LED IDs to URDF link names for color visualization.
